title: Signal: Pseudo-random generator constructed with a constant seed in csharp — review required
scope: Single-line match on a constant-seeded Random in csharp.
limitations: Lexical: matches a seeded Random constructor; an unseeded Random is reported by a separate rule.

examples.line: # audit: var rng = new Random(1234); present
